description: A 50 x 50 leg splayed 100 mm in X and Y over 700 mm, ending on the underside of a 100 x 40 rail (its top node sits on the rail's span). The leg leans acos(700 / 714.14) = 11.42 degrees from vertical, so its top cut is that angle; turning the leg on its side makes it a plain miter with no bevel. The underside is at z = 680, so along the axis the cut is at (680 -/+ 25 x 0.19803) / 0.98020 = 688.7 / 698.8. The bottom end is free and square.
